reviews.title: Sturdy, Waterproof, and Easy to Clean
reviews.body: I’ve been using the BigFoot Clear Shower Curtain Liner for a few weeks now, and I'm happy with my purchase.The material feels much more premium than the typical flimsy liners. It’s made from PEVA, so there’s no strong plastic smell right out of the package. It’s thick enough to hang nicely without clinging to you during a shower, but still flexible and easy to handle.The built-in magnets at the bottom add some weight to keep the liner in place against the tub, which helps prevent water from escaping onto the floor.I also appreciate that it’s truly waterproof and dries quickly. Water beads up and runs right off, so it doesn’t get that grimy, damp feeling. It's like Rain-X on your liner.Since it's machine washable, it's easy to keep clean and extend its lifespan instead of having to replace it over and over, which adds to its value.The grommets feel sturdy and hold up well with regular use, even when opening and closing the curtain daily. And they're rustproof so they will retain their color over time.If you’re looking for a reliable, odor-free shower liner that actually stays in place and holds up over time, this is a solid choice.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 11, 2026
reviews.author: Luke Varner

features: FEEL THE HEAVY-DUTY DIFFERENCE: This heavy duty shower curtain liner is made of 8G thick, premium PEVA material to resist rips and tears, saving you the cost and hassle of frequent replacements.
INVEST IN A SMARTER DESIGN: A reinforced top header and metal grommets mean this shower curtain with hooks hangs securely without tearing, ensuring reliable, long-term use where it matters most.
ELIMINATE ANNOYING BILLOWING: This weighted shower curtain liner features a weighted bottom hem that anchors securely to your tub, ensuring it hangs straight and stays put while you shower.
RECLAIM YOUR SHOWER SPACE: The perfect inside 72x72 shower curtain liner creates a comfortable barrier and stops the curtain from clinging to your body for a more relaxing, frustration-free shower.
STAYS CLEANER, LONGER: Treated to resist buildup, this plastic shower curtain liner keeps your space looking fresh. The slick PEVA surface helps prevent soap scum from forming.
